title: fix(spec): name requiresObject when an app menu entry names an undeclared platform object
body:
Fixes #37404

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 应用作者在菜单里放平台自带的任务或备忘入口却漏写依赖声明时,校验仍会拒绝,但报错现在直接告诉他补哪一项、不要自己再造一份对象;最终用户无感。
- 属于入门应用与空白模板的跟进工作,替照着平台文档写菜单的作者(含 AI)解决报错指错方向的问题。
- 只改报错文字与对象说明注释,不放宽也不收紧校验;出错时最坏是提示文字不准,可直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

- `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts`, app-navigation cross-reference check: the refusal for a `type: 'object'` entry naming an undeclared object is kept. When the name is platform-prefixed (`isPlatformObjectName`, the `sys_`/`cloud_`/`ai_` prefix test), the message keeps its first sentence unchanged and adds the fix: add `requiresObject: 'NAME'` to the entry (the menu hides it wherever the object is not registered) and do not declare a copy of the object in the package. A name without the prefix keeps the old message byte-for-byte.
- `sys_task` docblock now shows the entry with `requiresObject`; `sys_note` docblock gains the same sentence (it had none).
- New test `packages/spec/src/stack-nav-platform-object-requires-object.test.ts`.
- Changeset: patch for `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/platform-objects`.

Why the refusal stays rather than exempting by prefix: the prefix test matches plugin-contributed objects too (e.g. `sys_approval_request`), so an exemption would let a menu point at an object absent from the environment, with no runtime hiding.

## Tests

<details><summary>spec + platform-objects runs at e7621c876</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/stack-nav-platform-object-requires-object.test.ts src/stack-artifact-crossref.test.ts`: Test Files 2 passed, Tests 35 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: Test Files 901 passed (901), Tests 28508 passed, 1 todo.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects typecheck` (after building its dependency closure): exit 0; `src/work` tests 23 passed.
- Ablation: with the platform-prefix branch disabled on disk, the new file goes red (2 failed, 3 passed: both sys_ refusal cases); restored from HEAD, porcelain clean.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The curated `PLATFORM_OBJECTS_BY_PACKAGE['platform-objects']` list could tell objects every environment carries apart from plugin ones; exempting those would be a widening (shape A) and is not done here. It is raised to the seat as an open question.
- The published platform catalog skill text already teaches the entry with `requiresObject`; untouched.

## Verification

Read first: the `stack.zod.ts` hunk (message branch), then the new test.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/stack-nav-platform-object-requires-object.test.ts` shows 5 passed.
